plan.title: Increase RFQ Time by One Hour

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ summary containing the invited vendor's bid.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Apply the required RFQ counter-offer configuration.
Apply the required bidding-time rejection configuration.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Apply the required percentage counter-offer configuration.
Open the RFQ Settings action, choose “an hour,” confirm it, and verify the end time moves forward by 60 minutes.
Verify the required success toast after the extension is saved.
